title: RowlessCoverageFacet
description: How much of the lineage in this event rowless actually verified, and that nothing was executed to produce it. A catalog that cannot tell verified lineage from partially inferred lineage presents both as equally solid, which is the one way this emission could mislead people.

executed.description: Always false. These events come from a dry run: the pipeline was executed against frames with a schema and no rows, so no data was read or written and this is not a record of a production run.

confidence.description: exact when the engine resolved every column itself; partial when some columns are untyped or untraced; unknown when rowless lost confidence, which includes a failed dry run and row-dependent control flow.

verified.description: True only when confidence is exact. Present as well as confidence so a catalog that cannot branch on an enum can still filter.

columnsTyped.description: Columns with a known, non-ANY dtype.

columnsTraced.description: Columns with lineage evidence, so usable for blast-radius analysis.

reasons.description: Human-readable causes of lost confidence, as `rowless explain` prints them.
